title: Length bounds for binary increment
statement: For every finite Boolean word $w$, its incremented word has length at most $|w|+1$, and the number of initial consecutive true bits of $w$ is at most the length of the incremented word.
replaced: For every bit list $w$, the incremented list has length at most $|w| + 1$, and the carry count of $w$ is at most the length of the incremented list, so all cleared cells lie within the incremented word.
